entries.2f8f5991ac96e180: A reportable segment in which the company and its consolidated subsidiary RCI Co., Ltd. carry out tunnel interior and renewal works and repair and reinforcement works for concrete structures. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥10,331 million.
entries.3bd1ccd2180fca62: A specialist construction materials company that sells and installs construction materials such as post-installed anchors, and carries out tunnel interior and renewal work.
entries.7b5ee2e96d1643c0: A reportable segment mainly selling construction materials for post-installed anchors and carrying out seismic-related works. It also handles the proprietary “Sendan Hokyō RMA” construction method. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥8,140 million.
entries.97c14d317d13b553: A specialist construction materials company headquartered in Kita Ward, Osaka City. The company, its consolidated subsidiary RCI Co., Ltd. and two subsidiaries of the non-consolidated subsidiary Tangshan Nisshō Building Materials Technology Co., Ltd. make up the Group, and consolidated employees as of March 31, 2026 numbered 338. It is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.d1b2d530d1c5a121: A reportable segment mainly selling tunnel excavation materials. The non-consolidated subsidiary Tangshan Nisshō Building Materials Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells tunnel support materials in China. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,076 million.
